original_target.title: Explicit matrices with Valiant-scale rigidity

scope_comparison: No full match for a uniform polynomial-time polynomial-bit rational construction with superlinear rigidity at linear complex target rank. Volk Th1.1 solves a white-box remote-point problem dependent on a supplied subspace; section5 explicitly leaves constructing a single rigid matrix family with polynomial-bit coordinates open. Random matrices, huge encodings and finite-field variants do not meet the target.
